content.comment_body: Hello everyone! Is it possible to connect [product_name] to [product_name] [version_no]? In the connection options of [product_name], I don't see [product_name] or [version_no] listed. Is it possible to use the [version_no] connection instead? I've attached a screenshot for reference. Thanks for your assistance!

Hello, From what I know, [product_name] [version_no] does not include a built-in driver for [product_name] or [version_no]. You need to use [product_name] [version_no], where selecting [product_name] as a driver is straightforward. Hope this is helpful!

Hi, I don't think that's possible. If you're using the [product_name] SCADA, you'll also need the OPC server from [company_name]. As a suggestion, update your [product_name] firmware to [version_no]. Hope this information helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter difficulties when trying to connect [product_name] modules to [product_name] [version_no] because the necessary drivers are not available. The main problem stems from the lack of direct driver support for [product_name] and certain hardware within [product_name] [version_no], resulting in uncertainty about which connection method or software version to use. Recommendations include considering a different [product_name] version or utilizing an OPC server, which complicates a process users expect to be simple.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward integration between [product_name] hardware and [product_name] [version_no], featuring direct driver support or obvious configuration options within the software.
